title: Just okay
text:
Just okay. These lids are just okay. I use a lot of mason jars for food and all other sorts of storage needs in my house (crafting, homemade beauty supplies, etc.) and the normal canning lids get gross and rusty far too easily. So I was looking for a more permanent set of lids that I didn't have to worry about getting rusty and crumbling into my body scrub. Except they don't quite perfectly fit... The silicone seals are basically useless so I stopped even trying to use them. But even without the seals, it can take a few tries to get the lid to seat correctly so that it tightens all the way.

I'm not sure I trust these to be airtight, so I'm going to use them for mason jars with dry contents and I'm going to have to keep looking for the perfect lids for my soup and whatnot
